title: Spirited Away
tagline: A bathhouse for the spirits, and one human girl.
about: Ten-year-old Chihiro takes a job in a witch's bathhouse for spirits to save her parents, who ate the wrong feast and turned into pigs.
cue: Bring out the rice balls when Haku gives Chihiro onigiri after she finds her parents still pigs.
faces: "This is a high-class place I'm running here."

A bathhouse for the spirits, and one human girl.
Haku gives Chihiro rice balls. Salted rice balls, umeboshi, nori.
No-Face pays the staff in gold. Salmon and cucumber rolls, egg rolls, soy and pickled ginger.
Lin tosses them to the soot sprites.
Spirit town char siu pork buns
The feast that turns her parents into pigs. Sticky char siu pork, soft steamed buns, cucumber.
Kamaji bribes Lin with a roasted newt. Chicken and spring onion skewers, sweet soy glaze, rice.
Lin brings Sen a red bean bun. Soft steamed buns, sweet red bean paste.
Zeniba's iced barley tea with honey and yuzu
Zeniba makes everyone some tea. Roasted barley tea, honey, a squeeze of yuzu.
A treat for the new girl on the staff.
A tray charge applies to every order. Prices subject to change. Every drink is alcohol free. The stink spirit is a river spirit. Boh turned into a mouse. Form RS 10. Images: TMDB.

    To beginHaku's onigiri with pickled plumHaku gives Chihiro rice balls. Salted rice balls, umeboshi, nori.How to make it400g Japanese short-grain rice500ml water4 umeboshi pickled plums, stoned2 sheets of nori, cut in strips1 tsp sea salt1 tbsp toasted sesame seedsRinse the rice until the water runs clear, then cook it with the water, covered, on low heat.Rest the rice for 10 minutes off the heat, then spread it out to cool a little.Wet and salt your hands, take a handful of rice, push a piece of plum into the middle and press into a triangle.Wrap a strip of nori around the base of each and sprinkle with sesame.No-Face's feast sushi rollsNo-Face pays the staff in gold. Salmon and cucumber rolls, egg rolls, soy and pickled ginger.How to make it400g sushi rice60ml sushi seasoning4 sheets of nori150g sashimi-grade salmon, in strips1 Lebanese cucumber, in strips3 eggs1 tsp caster sugar60ml soy sauce50g pickled gingerCook the sushi rice, then fold through the seasoning and cool to room temperature.Beat the eggs with the sugar, cook into a thin omelette and cut into strips.Lay a nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread with rice, line up salmon and cucumber or egg, and roll up tightly.Slice each roll into 8 with a wet knife and serve with soy and ginger.Soot sprite star candies (konpeito)Lin tosses them to the soot sprites.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.From the kitchenSpirit town char siu pork bunsThe feast that turns her parents into pigs. Sticky char siu pork, soft steamed buns, cucumber.How to make it800g pork neck fillet80ml char siu sauce2 tbsp honey1 tbsp soy sauce12 frozen steamed bao buns1 Lebanese cucumber, sliced3 spring onions, shredded60ml hoisin sauceCoat the pork in the char siu sauce and leave for 15 minutes.Roast on a rack at 200°C for 35 minutes, then brush with honey and soy and roast 10 minutes more until sticky.Rest, then slice thinly.Steam the buns until soft and puffy.Fill each bun with hoisin, pork, cucumber and spring onion.Kamaji's boiler room chicken yakitoriKamaji bribes Lin with a roasted newt. Chicken and spring onion skewers, sweet soy glaze, rice.How to make it700g chicken thigh fillets, in cubes6 spring onions, in 3cm lengths80ml soy sauce60ml apple juice2 tbsp brown sugar1 tsp grated ginger300g Japanese short-grain rice12 bamboo skewers, soakedSimmer the soy, apple juice, sugar and ginger until syrupy, then cool.Cook the rice.Thread the chicken and spring onion onto the skewers.Grill over high heat, turning and brushing with the glaze, until charred and cooked through.Serve on the rice with the rest of the glaze.Something sweetLin's late-night red bean bunsLin brings Sen a red bean bun. Soft steamed buns, sweet red bean paste.How to make it300g plain flour2 tsp instant dried yeast1 tsp baking powder40g caster sugar170ml warm milk1 tbsp vegetable oil300g sweetened red bean pasteMix the flour, yeast, baking powder and sugar, then add the milk and oil and knead to a smooth dough.Cover and leave somewhere warm until puffy.Divide into 10, flatten each, wrap around a spoonful of bean paste and pinch closed.Sit each on a square of baking paper and steam over boiling water until puffed and springy.From the fountainZeniba's iced barley tea with honey and yuzuZeniba makes everyone some tea. Roasted barley tea, honey, a squeeze of yuzu.How to make it4 roasted barley tea bags (mugicha)1 L boiling water3 tbsp honey2 tbsp yuzu juice or lemon juice2 cups ice cubesSteep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then remove and stir in the honey.Cool, add the yuzu and chill.Pour over ice to serve.Chilled melon sodaA treat for the new girl on the staff.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
